Upon opening an ancient casket, a player can expect to receive an assortment of rewards pertaining to Archaeology and Treasure Trails. The casket is destroyed in the process.
Each casket makes several rolls for various drops:
• 3-5 damaged artefacts, regardless of the player's Archaeology level.
• 4-6 rolls on the materials drop table, regardless of the player's Archaeology level.
• 2-4 rolls of Archaeology supplies (excluding the mattock and tomes)
• 1-2 complete tomes
• Guaranteed elite or master clue scroll roll
• 1 of the following:
• 2-4 pages from the Treasure Trails rewards
• 1 of the other Treasure Trails rewards (excluding clues)
• 1 of the rewards (or reward set) from the Miscellaneous rewards
• Dragon mattock (1% chance)
The average ancient casket gives worth of materials. Including miscellaneous rewards, the average value is . Including the shadowy key roll and clue scroll rewards as well, the average value is . These numbers don't include the money saved on binding contract materials or possible profit from restoring obtained artefacts.
It can be stored in the bank. In order to open an ancient casket, the player must also have a combined total of 25 spaces free in their backpack or bank.
If the player's backpack or bank is too full to hold all of the rewards, the remaining items can be later reclaimed from the ancient casket located next to the research desk on the upper floor of the Archaeology Guild.
Since the complete tomes cannot be banked, they will remain in the ancient casket in the Archaeology Guild. Lobbying or logging out and back in will return the complete tomes to the backpack.

Making a cup of tea requires level 20 Cooking and gives the player 52 experience. The following furniture must be present in the player-owned house: a stove, a larder, a shelf, and optionally a sink.
• Remove a kettle, a teapot and one or more cups from the shelf.
• Remove one unit of tea leaves from the larder.
• Use the kettle on the sink (or any other water source, even outside of a player-owned house) to fill it with water.
• Use the full kettle of water on the range to bring it to a boil.
• Use the tea leaves on the teapot to turn it into a teapot with leaves.
• Use the hot kettle on the teapot with leaves to create four servings of tea. This is the only step that grants Cooking experience.
• Use the pot of tea on a cup to pour a cup of tea.
• Use a bucket of milk on the cup of tea.

The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Using protean hides or unstable protean hide
• Playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 20) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value

When training gathering skills, which are Archaeology, Divination, Farming, Fishing, Hunter, Mining, and Woodcutting, with the necklace equipped, a Seren spirit (supplemented with a notification and sound) has a 10% chance to spawn once per minute on the first eligible XP drop, lasting 30 seconds. A Seren Spirit may spawn when training any aspect of a gathering skill, even if the action itself is not any form of gathering (e.g. restoring an artefact).
When interacted with, the Seren spirit deposits a random drop from the rare drop table into the bank. This may include a Hazelmere's signet ring or Vecna skull provided that the player has a tier 4 luck effect upon interaction. If the bank is full, the item is deposited into the backpack. If the backpack is also full, the item is dropped onto the ground.
Interacting with the Seren spirit does not interrupt gathering actions. It will also appear if protean items are being used to train these skills. It is possible to spawn more than one Seren spirit at once through stalling with an interface and having the additional experience drops roll into the next few minutes. Having an active Spirit attraction potion effect while the spirit spawns will automatically collect the spirit.
